text:
Situation: Dextrose monohydrate has been on the FDA shortage list since 2022-01-13 and remains current as of 2026-10-21. The list includes Amphastar Pharmaceuticals, B. Braun Medical Inc., Baxter Healthcare, Hospira Inc., Otsuka ICU Medical LLC, and Fresenius Kabi USA. Corvale East holds 2.4 days of 50 g/1000 mL 250 mL bags, 3.5 days of 70 g/100 mL, and 5.2 days of 50 mg/mL 50 mL. Corvale General holds 16.7 days of 50 g/1000 mL, 19.5 days of 70 g/100 mL, and 15.7 days of 50 mg/mL. Corvale Lakeside holds 9 days of 50 g/1000 mL 250 mL bags.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage on 2022-01-13; status is current as of 2026-10-21. B. Braun FEI 2021236 received an OAI classification letter on 2020-10-22 and an OAI inspection ended 2025-11-21. Hospira FEI 1021343 had OAI inspections ending 2010-01-19, 2011-06-17, and 2011-08-04, and a VAI inspection ending 2019-11-21. Class I recall D-1257-2020 by B. Braun on 2020-04-18 and Class II recalls by Baxter on 2020-10-07, B. Braun on 2023-03-01 and 2023-05-09, and Baxter on 2023-03-15 and 2023-08-11 involve dextrose-containing products.

Our position: Internal transfers can stabilize Corvale East within days using existing Corvale General stock while preserving two weeks at General. External purchases from suppliers not on the FDA shortage list are available as backup.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 89 bags of 50 g/1000 mL 250 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Transfer 180 units of 70 g/100 mL 2000 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
3. Transfer 63 units of 50 mg/mL 50 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
4. Place purchase orders with ICU Medical Inc. — approved by buyer.
5. Place purchase orders with Becton Dickinson and Company — approved by buyer.

Not recommended: Delay transfers pending new vendor qualifications; rely solely on Corvale Lakeside stock; initiate compounding without committee review.
